whenToUse: A one-page personal site and printable CV for an engineer, designer or freelancer.
People who want a print-perfect A4 CV from the same content.
avoidWhen: A visual work portfolio — use site-portfolio-01.
A studio or team site — use site-studio-01.
a11y: Section navigation marks the current item with aria-current; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Check the printed CV still reads in a logical order without colour.
